display_name: Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ): Recode for Symptom Stability
description:
The Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ) is a 23-item, self-administered questionnaire designed to evaluate the health status of heart failure (HF) patients by quantifying physical limitations, symptoms (frequency, severity and recent change over time), social limitations, self-efficacy, and quality of life. [Green CP 2000 (PubMed ID: 10758967)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10758967/)

[Search for all KCCQ variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/loftdatasets/lofthf/variables?search=kccq)
